title: Exit Skills
text: Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:
items: Design software solutions using algorithmic problem-solving methodologies.
Develop, test, and debug Python programs.
Utilize functions and modular programming techniques.
Work with collections and file processing techniques.
Evaluate program correctness, efficiency, and maintainability.
Analyze and validate AI-assisted programming solutions.
Analyze problems, develop algorithms, and implement software solutions using appropriate programming methodologies.
